mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.baby_id, m.user_id, m.role_tag, m.display_name, m.status, m.last_heartbeat, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar, u.status as user_status, case when m.last_heartbeat is not null and m.last_heartbeat > (current_timestamp - interval '45 seconds') then '1' else '0' end as online_flag from nc_baby_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id
mapper.update: update nc_baby_member set last_heartbeat = current_timestamp where baby_id = #{babyId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
